blurb: Mass Firearms offers a variety of firearms safety and license classes including the Massachusetts Basic Firearms Safety Course required for LTC or FID licenses. Classes include live fire shooting and cover legalities, tactics, and techniques for self-defense and concealed carry. Private and ladies-only classes are available, as well as advanced and specialized training sessions.
